title: Art 201 · Fine Arts & Visual Studio
permanentRoutine: Observe → Experiment → Compose → Make → Critique → Revise → Curate

assessmentModel.weekly: open-book discipline-authentic evidence plus mastery check where appropriate
assessmentModel.correction: below 80% requires targeted correction/revision before reassessment
assessmentModel.protectedBoundary: browser-local drafts and self-checks do not create transcript credit

weeks.title: Studio habits, observation & visual inquiry
weeks.essentialQuestion: How can careful observation and experimentation generate stronger visual ideas?

days.task: Retrieve a prior idea or inspect a new example connected to Studio habits, observation & visual inquiry. Identify what you notice, what you already know, and one question worth testing.
days.evidence: retrieval note or annotated observation tied to Studio habits, observation & visual inquiry

days.task: Study the core concepts, vocabulary, and a worked model for Studio habits, observation & visual inquiry. Explain why the model works and where it could fail or mislead.
days.evidence: annotated model with vocabulary used in context

days.task: Complete guided practice for Studio habits, observation & visual inquiry. Compare at least two examples, alternatives, or interpretations and justify the stronger choice with evidence.
days.evidence: guided analysis or practice artifact

days.task: Apply Studio habits, observation & visual inquiry in a new situation. Build, perform, design, plan, or solve something authentic to the discipline, then test it against explicit criteria.
days.evidence: observation studies and process journal

days.task: Revise the week's work after feedback or self-check. Defend one decision, name one limitation, and identify what should transfer to a later week.
days.evidence: revised artifact, reflection, and short defense

weeks.vocabularyTarget: 5–9 discipline terms taught through use, examples, and retrieval

masteryCheck.retake: targeted correction then parallel-form or revised evidence
